# Third-party notices for `tla2tools.jar`

This directory redistributes an unchanged TLA+ Tools binary from the [TLA+ project](https://github.com/tlaplus/tlaplus). The corresponding upstream source is available at revision [`9787e65714c37d94eebab40774bff401bd9f616d`](https://github.com/tlaplus/tlaplus/tree/9787e65714c37d94eebab40774bff401bd9f616d), together with the upstream build instructions.

The JAR contains its original license material:

- `License.txt` contains the Microsoft Research MIT License notice.
- `META-INF/LICENSE.md` contains the Eclipse Public License 2.0 text, its GPL secondary-license text, and notices for bundled components.

Those files remain inside `tla2tools.jar` byte-for-byte. This project does not remove, replace, or reinterpret them. The artifact identity and original acquisition URL are recorded in [README.md](README.md).

This notice records the engineering provenance used by this project. It is not legal advice or a substitute for reviewing the embedded licenses before redistribution in another product.
